functions.description: Extract core System block fields from Windows XML event (provider, event id, timestamp, host, user SID)
Extract raw EventData block as message for XML-formatted Windows events

conf.regex: /eventsourcename=(?<provider>.*?) guid=(?<guid>\{[^}]+\}) name=(?<message>.*?) processid=(?<process_id>\d+) qualifiers=(?<qualifiers>\d+) systemtime=(?<timestamp>\S+) threadid=(?<thread_id>\d+) userid=(?<user_sid>\S+) xmlns=/

functions.description: Extract fields from KVP-formatted Windows event (provider, guid, message, process/thread ids, timestamp, user SID)

add.name: action
add.value: event_id === '7045' ? 'service_installed' : event_id === '7036' ? 'service_state_change' : event_id === '7040' ? 'service_config_change' : event_id === '1074' ? 'shutdown_restart' : event_id === '41' ? 'unexpected_shutdown' : (message && message.indexOf('service was installed') !== -1) ? 'service_installed' : (message && message.indexOf('entered the running state') !== -1) ? 'service_state_change' : (message && message.indexOf('start type of the') !== -1) ? 'service_config_change' : (message && message.indexOf('has initiated the restart') !== -1) ? 'shutdown_restart' : 'unknown'

functions.description: Derive _time from extracted timestamp and normalize action based on event_id or message content

add.name: dest_ip
add.value: dest_ip || dst_ip || destination__ip || server__ip || dstaddr || dstip

add.name: dest_port
add.value: dest_port || dst_port || destination__port || dpt || dstport || dport

add.name: log_time
add.value: log_time || generated_time || receive_time || start_time || event__created || timestamp || event__start

(src_ip || srcaddr || srcip || src) : undefined

add.name: dst_endpoint.ip
add.value: (dest_ip || dst_ip || dstaddr || dstip || dst) != null && String(dest_ip || dst_ip || dstaddr || dstip || dst) != 'undefined' && String(dest_ip || dst_ip || dstaddr || dstip || dst) != 'null' && String(dest_ip || dst_ip || dstaddr || dstip || dst) != '-' && String(dest_ip || dst_ip || dstaddr || dstip || dst) != '' ? (user || src_user || suser || username) : undefined

add.name: device.hostname
add.value: (host || hostname || devname || dvchost) != null && String(host || hostname || devname || dvchost) != 'undefined' && String(host || hostname || devname || dvchost) != 'null' && String(host || hostname || devname || dvchost) != '-' && String(host || hostname || devname || dvchost) != '' ? (host || hostname || devname || dvchost) : undefined

add.name: message
add.value: (message || msg || _raw) != null && String(message || msg || _raw) != 'undefined' && String(message || msg || _raw) != 'null' && String(message || msg || _raw) != '-' && String(message || msg || _raw) != '' ? (message || msg || _raw) : undefined

add.name: _time
add.value: (log_time) && (/^\d{13}$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) : /^\d{10}$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) * 1000 : /^\d{13}\.\d+$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) : /^\d{10}\.\d+$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) * 1000 : new Date(String(log_time)).getTime()) ? (/^\d{13}$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) : /^\d{10}$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) * 1000 : /^\d{13}\.\d+$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) : /^\d{10}\.\d+$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) * 1000 : new Date(String(log_time)).getTime()) / 1000 : _time
